messages:
hana: Heads-up: NovaEdge POC failing their CI due to fncall JSON where 'trade_id' is sometimes null and the key ordering changes. They want a fix before demo.
oscar: paste failing sample and logs pls.
hana: sample: {"trade_id": null, "amount": 8100, "status": "PENDING"}

infra-bot: log: [2026-03-21T22:00:12Z] req=aa11 model=redwood-2-stream mode=json error=schema_violation field=trade_id; rate_limit=429 Retry-After=3

leah: root cause looks like streaming chunk boundary producing truncated or literal null tokens plus client retry storms causing quota 429s.
oscar: mitigation options: 1) provide non-streaming validation endpoint for CI (streaming=false) 2) enable deterministic serializer (json_mode.stable_key_order=true) and drop_nulls=true for validation only 3) recommend client backoff honoring Retry-After 4) offer short dedicated pool trial to prevent shared-quota flakiness.
hana: can we push the canary toggles and give them a temporary QPS bump? They'll rerun CI in 20m.
leah: pushed canary. infra-bot: config-change by leah for route/novaedge-poc {"json_mode":{"stable_key_order":true,"drop_nulls":true},"streaming":false} rolling to canary

infra-bot: canary check: 10 validation runs, 0 schema_violations. Some client retry bursts seen outside canary.
oscar: approved temporary QPS bump to 450 for 2h.
hana: NovaEdge ran CI against canary and passed. Follow-ups: leah to open INF ticket for permanent fix and tests; oscar to send pricing note for discounted dedicated trial; hana to draft one-paragraph attestation about PII; client wants explicit note that drop_nulls is temporary.
leah: INF-13009 created: "NovaEdge POC - streaming json nulls + deterministic serializer" https://go.redwood/infracase/INF-13009
hana: Thanks team. Closing unless it reappears. :white_check_mark:
